name: notify
description: Native desktop notifications when Claude needs your input, finishes a long turn, hits an error, or a subagent finishes.

onNeedsInput.title: Notify when input is needed
onNeedsInput.description: Permission prompts, idle prompts and AskUserQuestion dialogs.

onTurnDone.title: Notify when a long turn finishes
onTurnDone.description: A turn that ran longer than the minimum turn length below.

minTurnSeconds.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Only turns that ran longer than this many seconds send a 'done' notification.

onError.title: Notify on errors
onError.description: API errors and turns that failed.

onSubagentDone.title: Notify when a subagent finishes
onSubagentDone.description: Names the agent's task in the notification.

sound.title: Sound (macOS)
sound.description: macOS sound name (Glass, Ping, Hero, Submarine, ...); empty for silent.

onlyWhenUnfocused.title: Only when the terminal is in the background
onlyWhenUnfocused.description: macOS: skip notifications while your terminal app is the frontmost app. Ignored where focus cannot be read.
